# A policy recommending what it does not require

`Policy: pol-ADVS` `ACTIVE`

## Purpose

To state one clause that binds and one that recommends, so a deviation can depart from the second.

## Scope

This fixture only.

## Clauses

| Id       | Clause                                              | Alignment |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `NAME`   | **MUST** name every store in the estate register.   |           |
| `PREFIX` | SHOULD give each store a prefix naming its service. |           |
